task.title: Access the Magnetic Field Time Waveform
task.shortdesc: This section describes the process of accessing the magnetic field time waveform graph.

context.p: This section describes the process of accessing the magnetic field time waveform graph.
To access the Magnetic Field Time Waveform through the application:

step.cmd: Select the location associated with the motor.
From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding process, plant, and motor name.
Tap Select Vibration to select Magnetic field time waveform.
Tap Select Date and Select Time to select the date and time corresponding to the moment of the installation.

info.p: You should see the corresponding waveform as shown in Figure 31. placeholder

step.cmd: Click DATA DOWNLOADto download the generated data.
